## load packages and data

```{r message=F}
rm(list = ls())

library(psych) # v.2.4.6.26
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1
library(ggplot2) # v.4.0.2
library(ggpubr) # v.0.6.0
library(tidyr) # v.1.3.1
library(see) # v.0.12.0
library(afex) # v.1.5-1
library(ggdist) # v3.3.3

df_commMeasures_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "coupling_comm_measures.csv"), sep=",")

df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "coupling_comm_measures_frontoparietal.csv"), sep=",")

df_commMeasures_rawfunc_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "rawfunc_coupling_comm_measures.csv"), sep=",")

df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rawfunc_raw <- 
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "rawfunc_coupling_comm_measures_frontoparietal.csv"), sep=",")

df_BIS <- 
  read.csv(here("Data", "BIS_Complete_processed.csv"), sep = ";")

load(here("Data", "APM.RData"))

df_CD_raw <-
  read.csv(here("Analysis_data", "G04_CD_in_timewindows_4subs_removed.csv"), sep = ",")

```

## prepare dataset

```{r}
data_outlier <- dataACC
data_outlier$PropCorrOdd <- NA
data_outlier$PropCorrEven <- NA

data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorr = mean(Accuracy))
data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorrOdd = mean(Accuracy[Odd_Even == 1]))
data_outlier <- data_outlier %>% group_by(Subject) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorrEven = mean(Accuracy[Odd_Even == 2]))
data_outlier <- data_outlier%>% filter(RTms >= 150) 

dataACC <- data_outlier #dataACC = column with percentage correct and only trials with RT > 150 ms

APM <- as.matrix(dataACC[,c("Subject", "PropCorrOdd", "PropCorrEven", "PropCorr")])
APM <- unique(APM)

df_intelligence <- merge(df_BIS, APM, by = "Subject", all = TRUE)
df_intelligence$numcorrect <- 36*df_intelligence$PropCorr

# remove invalid participants (participants took IQ test but were not included in the sample due to exclusion criteria such as color blindness)
df_intelligence <- df_intelligence[-c(216, 217, 218, 219, 220, 221, 222),]
df_intelligence <- df_intelligence[, c("Subject", "PC_Mean", "PS_Mean", "M_Mean", "C_Mean", "g_Mean", "PropCorrOdd", "PropCorrEven")]

df_intelligence$PC_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PC_Mean)) 
df_intelligence$PS_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PS_Mean))
df_intelligence$M_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$M_Mean))
df_intelligence$C_Mean <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$C_Mean))
df_intelligence$PropCorrOdd <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PropCorrOdd))
df_intelligence$PropCorrEven <- as.numeric(scale(df_intelligence$PropCorrEven))
```

## clean data
```{r}
# communication measures
df_commMeasures = df_commMeasures_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures)) {
  sample_mean = mean(df_commMeasures[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  sample_SD = sd(df_commMeasures[,x], na.rm = TRUE)
  df_commMeasures[,x][df_commMeasures[,x] >
                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_commMeasures[,x][df_commMeasures[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures))
num_NAs_generated_commMeasures <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_commMeasures <- num_NAs_generated_commMeasures/(nrow(df_commMeasures)*5)

# communication measures frontoparietal
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal = df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal)) {

                        sample_mean+3*sample_SD] <- NA
  df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[,x][df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[,x] <
                        sample_mean-3*sample_SD] <- NA

}

final_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal))
num_NAs_generated_commMeasure_fp <- final_NA_count - initial_NA_count
percentage_Exclusion_commMeasures_fp <- num_NAs_generated_commMeasure_fp/(nrow(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal)*5)


# communication measures rawfunc
df_commMeasures_rawfunc = df_commMeasures_rawfunc_raw
initial_NA_count <- sum(is.na(df_commMeasures_rawfunc))

for (x in 2:ncol(df_commMeasures_rawfunc)) {
```

## calculate chronbachs alpha for BIS subscales and split half reliability for APM

```{r}
#BIS
alpha_PS <- psych::alpha(df_BIS[1:215,c("BD_score", "TG_score", "XG_score")]) # PS
alpha_PC <- psych::alpha(df_BIS[1:215,c("AN_score", "WA_score", "ZN_score", "CH_score", "SC_score", "TM_score")]) #PC
alpha_M <- psych::alpha(df_BIS[1:215,c("OG_score", "ST_score", "ZP_score")]) # M
alpha_C <- psych::alpha(df_BIS[1:215,c("LO_score", "EF_score", "DR_score")]) #C

alpha_total <- psych::alpha(df_BIS[1:215,c("BD_score", "TG_score", "XG_score",
                                     "AN_score", "WA_score", "ZN_score", 
                                     "CH_score", "SC_score", "TM_score", 
                                     "OG_score", "ST_score", "ZP_score",
                                     "LO_score", "EF_score", "DR_score")]) 

alpha_PS$total # 0.47
alpha_PC$total # 0.77
alpha_M$total # 0.60
alpha_C$total # 0.44
alpha_total$total # 0.80

#APM
r <- cor(df_intelligence$PropCorrOdd,df_intelligence$PropCorrEven, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
sh_reliability <- (2 * r) / (1 + r)
cat("Odd-Even reliability of Advanced Progressive matrices is", sh_reliability)

```

## test difference between whole-brain and frontoparietal Background FC

```{r}
df_commMeasures_long <- df_commMeasures_long %>%
  mutate(Region = "Whole-brain")

df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_long <- df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_long %>%
  mutate(Region = "Frontoparietal")

dat <- bind_rows(df_commMeasures_long, df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_long)

dat$Subject <- factor(dat$Subject)
dat$Region <- factor(dat$Region)
dat$Measure <- factor(dat$Measure)

# prepare for t-tests per measure
wide <- dat %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Subject, Measure),
    names_from = Region,
    values_from = Value
  )

t_results <- wide %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>%
  summarise(
    t = t.test(
      `Whole-brain`,
      Frontoparietal,
      paired = TRUE
    )$statistic,
    
    p = t.test(
      `Whole-brain`,
      Frontoparietal,
      paired = TRUE
    )$p.value,
    
    df = t.test(
      `Whole-brain`,
      Frontoparietal,
      paired = TRUE
    )$parameter,
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Holm correction for p-values
t_results <- t_results %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p, method = "holm")
  )

t_results
```

## test difference of early and late CD in task conditions

```{r}
df_CD_long <- df_CD %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ERPset,
    names_to = c("Time", "Condition"),
    names_sep = "_CD_",
    values_to = "CD"
  )

df_CD_long$Condition <- factor(df_CD_long$Condition)
df_CD_long$Time <- factor(df_CD_long$Time, levels = c("E", "L"))
df_CD_long$ERPset   <- factor(df_CD_long$ERPset)

anova_result <- aov_ez(
  id = "ERPset",
  dv = "CD",
  data = df_CD_long,
  within = c("Time", "Condition")
)

anova_result

df_CD_stats <-df_CD[,2:9] %>%
  describe() %>%
  round(2)

# Delta CD between early and late time window
df_CD_stats$mean[5:8]-df_CD_stats$mean[1:4]
```


## combine data

```{r}
df_commMeasures[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures[, 2:6])
df_commMeasures_rawfunc[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures_rawfunc[, 2:6])
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[, 2:6] <- scale(df_commMeasures_frontoparietal[, 2:6])

df_commMeasures_rawfunc$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures_rawfunc$Subject))
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures_frontoparietal$Subject))
df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rawfunc$Subject <- as.numeric(sub("sub-", "", df_commMeasures_frontoparietal_rawfunc$Subject))

df <- df_commMeasures %>%
  select(Subject, DE, "–SI", PT, RE, C) %>%
  full_join(
    df_intelligence %>%
```

```{r}
## check for univariate normality
which_df <- df # chose df, df_rawfunc, df_frontoparietal, df_frontoparietal_rawfunc
summary_stats <- describe(which_df[,2:21])
range(summary_stats$skew)
range(summary_stats$kurtosis)

```
